hypothesis: mint03 on llama3.2:3b, host langgraph_react: the model-invisible host_derive hook certifies at least 2x as many dev cells as the frozen 5-clause chain does, at a host_value_correct of >=0.9 among computed cells, with the availability-only and document_order controls both failing to reproduce it. Pooled decision is taken across all eight mint03 run_ids per docs/handoffs/MINT03_PREREG_2026-09-08.md; this slice contributes its 12 cells and its own per-model read, and cannot promote on its own.
notes: See docs/handoffs/MINT03_PREREG_2026-09-08.md for the full corpus design, the endpoint definitions, the controls and the pre-declared abort rules; it governs, this file is the machine-checkable denominator for ONE (model x host) slice of it. Gate artifact for this campaign: the Phase-2e replay verdict in docs/handoffs/HOST_DERIVE_REPLAY_2026-09-08.md (host_value_correct 1.000 on 113/113 computed rows; availability 41.7% on the derive-on stratum, 39.8% pooled). host_derive is MODEL-INVISIBLE: it is a finish-time host hook that makes no model call and changes no prompt or tool list, so there is NO host_derive on/off LLM arm -- every mint03 cell runs LEDGER_HOST_MODULES=derive,answer_audit,shape_derive,host_derive and the host-on/host-off contrast is taken POST-HOC from these same cells (host_certified vs the frozen 5-clause chain 'certified', plus the availability-only and document_order controls). The arms recorded here are the two HOSTS; this file pins one of them so scripts/prereg.py audit evaluates completion for that host alone and a dead host cannot be averaged away. reps=1 because LLM_SEED is process-global: a second rep under the same seed duplicates the cell and inflates every t by sqrt(2). Seed 22222 and corpus numeric22 are mint02's, so the model-visible surface is unchanged from mint02 apart from the host-invisible hook. No arm-vs-arm and no model-vs-model SCORE claim is permitted from this run. Holdout tasks 213/217/221 are run and reported in a separate block; no decision rests on them.
primary_endpoint: PRIMARY (amended 2026-09-08 before launch, user decision): UNION certified coverage -- a dev cell is accepted if the frozen 5-clause chain certifies it OR host_certified holds -- must be >= 1.5x chain-only certified coverage, at risk no worse than chain-only (wrong-acceptance rate among accepted cells, exact-binomial CP upper bound reported), denominator = ALL dev cells (tasks 210-212,214-216,218-220), read from scripts/ledger_risk_coverage.py --prefix mint03 section host_vs_chain (union vs chain_certified) with per-model rows from host_derive_dev_derive_on.by_model / strata_by_model_dev_derive_on. Success needs BOTH the pooled bar (all four models, both hosts, 72 dev cells) AND >=3 of 4 models with union coverage non-decreasing vs that model's own chain coverage. Rationale: 2e showed host and chain certify DISJOINT cells (intersection 0/156), so host-alone vs chain measures substitution, not the coverage-at-risk KPI; on stored cells union was 12.2% at 0% risk vs chain 7.1%, i.e. 1.7x -- the bar is failable in either direction live. SECONDARY (was the primary; demoted, not an outcome): host_certified alone >= 2x chain. CO-PRIMARY: host_value_correct >= 0.9 among cells where the host computed a value (section host_value_correct_rate.dev_derive_on.rate); the 2e replay measured 1.000 on stored pages, so a live drop below 0.9 is the mechanism failing on fresh pages and fails the campaign on its own. Risk (wrong acceptances among host_certified cells) is REPORTED as a Clopper-Pearson 95% upper bound and is decision-bearing only at >=59 accepted cells; with 72 dev cells that needs 82% coverage and will not happen, so risk is a readout this phase, not a gate. Controls printed in the same table and required to hold: the availability-only baseline must NOT match host_certified (identical numbers mean the agreement test is inert), and the document_order ranker ablation (scripts/host_derive_replay.py --prefixes mint03 --rankers document_order,hand_rule) must stay below the hand rule. No single-model pass promotes; conditional-on-available coverage is never the endpoint; secondary metrics may not be reported as outcomes.
